summary.substantiveImprovement: 8gap实际有地坪/院栏/巷路承接，锦架与器物台有民俗叙事，已超出原单调空山占位。
summary.rejectionReason: 原不透明浅灰绿水脉横带和扁平TR树冠在新景前割断完整物体；6段同屋顶院廊机械重复。
summary.otherFindings: 未另见独立的新台脚悬浮、新题签遮挡或把天空填满的问题。低地坪不应全部删掉，须保留真实承托并减少有顶建筑重复。
summary.notFinalAcceptance: 资产生成/包装完成不等于场景通过，须修占位层和空间节奏后重审。

coordinateSystem.format: [x,y,width,height], all 0..1; rectangles are observed visual regions, not placement commands

coordinateSystem.precision: visual approximate +-0.025 in normalized coordinates; validate projected geometry against the actual current view before integration
coordinateSystem.regionOverlap: Where lower support overlaps central gap, the support is a separately planned depth role, not additional area to fill twice.

opaque-water-ribbon.evidence: 多帧约y.67–.78实色条截断锦布、花瓶、灯、墙；不是合格水面/气口。

flat-canopy-placeholders.evidence: 新锦布/花枝前出现三四瓣灰色树冠图标，风格和遮挡均不合理。
flat-canopy-placeholders.action: 定位TR疏林/树冠系列，只退役明确占位辅助；保留实际手绘树木。
